candidate_prompt: The image shows candidate boxes with integer labels. Which visible candidate is a chair? Answer exactly one integer label, or NONE. No other text.
context_transport: two images supplied to the processor in order: annotated full view, then crop contact sheet; this has a larger visual-token budget than a single image and is not a pure presentation-method gain.
label_permutation: reverse the candidate display-label order once on the full annotated view; it is a positional-bias robustness control, not an accuracy measurement.
